_note: Graph-truth retrieval cohort for search_policy (Beyond Chunk and Pray methodology). Each case is a customer question whose expected_answer is the value that lives in the policy graph (data/gms_policy_store_cap). Retrieval is graded by benchmark_retrieval: parse the question -> bind to a (head, relation, tail) triple -> retrieve -> hit iff the retrieved value matches expected_answer; every miss localizes to parse/bind/retrieve. This replaces the coarse top-k policy-label recall. Includes the disambiguation-prone pairs (dispute filing vs investigation window; Reg E threshold vs escalation window) so the metric surfaces same-head relation confusion honestly.
